A newly created Fighter starts with: **Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, and Torches** (item IDs 2, 15, 17, 23).

Defined in `worker/src/services/character.ts:65` (`CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` constant, Fighter entry), with item IDs resolved to names via the `items` table seeded in `worker/src/db/seed.sql` (insert order determines IDs). Note: per docs, ID 23 is actually "Torches" though a code comment mislabels it "Rations" (bug B-09).
